page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance provides 32 vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, alongside 128.0 GB of dedicated system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, such as stress-ng single-core CPU and Geekbench single-core scores, fall into the weak category, with single-threaded gzip compression rated as poor. However, the 32-vCPU allocation elevates multi-core performance to average levels across stress-ng multi-core, PassMark CPU, and Geekbench multi-core tests. Memory bandwidth for both cached and uncached reads and writes also performs within the average tier.

Given its hardware profile and performance characteristics, this instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that can leverage parallel processing rather than high single-thread performance. The balanced resource density makes it suitable for multi-threaded applications, static web serving, Redis database operations, and medium-sized language model inference tasks, where it achieves average throughput. It is less suitable for single-threaded processing or workloads requiring local NVMe storage.
